author: UnvoicedTiger6
body:
Hello. I am writing this because I just got this account from a friend of mine who no longer uses this account, so I believe that I should be able to have a clear start.

date of ban: march 30, 2015.
Why I was banned: ban evasion (Remeh_). Like I stated above, remeh doesnt use this account anymore, and you can even use your ip check for as long as you need to see that he will no longer have access to the account.

Why I should be unbanned: I think I should be unbanned since I am new to multiplayer minecraft, and my friend remeh_ gave me this account to use since he uses a different one now which is his. he recommended this server to me so i really wanna give it a try but i am banned so i cannot do that. I ensure you that remeh will no longer be in control of this account, so there will no longer be any "ban evading".
thank you for reading,
Jacob

replies.body: You won't be unbanned. This is against the EULA, rules enforced by minecraft. You must buy an account from Mojang if you wish to play minecraft.
